headline: On last trading day, Sensex slipped into the red while Nifty gained 75 points amid volatile trading.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Geopolitical developments in the Middle East impacted crude oil outlook and global sentiment.
Investors maintained caution ahead of FII activity updates and crude price trends.
FinMin scheduled talks with PSB chiefs to address potential disruptions from an upcoming three-day bank strike.
Government warnings regarding cyberattack risks during the semiconductor ecosystem expansion weighed on sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex faced selling pressure to slip into the red, while Nifty managed a 75-point gain.
Paytm stock remains in spotlight following recent market headlines and focus ahead of the new week.
Boardroom discussions and strategic updates at Tata Sons drew significant market attention.
Pilots body FIP called for a thorough safety evaluation of B787 electrical systems following the AI171 crash.

summary: On the last trading day, the Sensex slipped into the red while the Nifty managed to gain 75 points despite broader market volatility. Investor sentiment was shaped by geopolitical tension, crude oil movement, and upcoming bank strike discussions. Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21.
